name: Gradient entry ranking and comparison
description: Canonical test vectors for gradient table entry ranking (spec section 11). Entries are compared by (source_priority, seq_num, -hop_count) where higher wins. Sequence numbers use RFC 1982 serial arithmetic. GradientEntry is internal state; these vectors validate comparison logic, not wire format.

source_priority.name: announce_beats_data
source_priority.description: ANNOUNCE (priority 1) outranks DATA (priority 0) even with worse seq_num and hop_count

source_priority.name: same_priority_explicit_sources
source_priority.description: ANNOUNCE and RREP have equal priority (both 1); falls through to seq_num

source_priority.name: data_vs_data_falls_through
source_priority.description: DATA vs DATA (both priority 0) falls through to seq_num comparison

seq_num_comparison.name: fresher_seq_wins
seq_num_comparison.description: Same priority and hop_count, fresher seq_num wins (RFC 1982)

seq_num_comparison.name: seq_wrap_forward
seq_num_comparison.description: Seq 0 is fresher than 65535 after wrap (RFC 1982: diff=1 < 32768)

seq_num_comparison.name: seq_wrap_backward_stale
seq_num_comparison.description: Seq 65535 is stale vs seq 0 (RFC 1982: diff=65535 >= 32768, not fresher)

seq_num_comparison.name: seq_half_boundary_tie
seq_num_comparison.description: Seq 32768 vs seq 0: diff=32768 is NOT < 32768, neither is fresher (tie, falls through to hop_count)

seq_num_comparison.name: seq_half_minus_one_is_fresher
seq_num_comparison.description: Seq 32767 vs seq 0: diff=32767 < 32768, so is fresher

seq_num_comparison.name: seq_wrap_near_boundary
seq_num_comparison.description: Seq 5 vs seq 65530: forward wrap of 11 is fresher

seq_num_comparison.name: equal_seq_falls_through
seq_num_comparison.description: Equal seq_num falls through to hop_count comparison

hop_count_comparison.name: fewer_hops_wins
hop_count_comparison.description: Same priority and seq_num, fewer hops wins

hop_count_comparison.name: more_hops_loses
hop_count_comparison.description: More hops loses when priority and seq_num are equal

hop_count_comparison.name: equal_rank_tie
hop_count_comparison.description: Identical priority, seq_num, and hop_count is a tie (a_wins=true by >= semantics)

combined_ranking.name: priority_trumps_all
combined_ranking.description: Higher priority wins despite much worse seq_num and hop_count

combined_ranking.name: seq_trumps_hops
combined_ranking.description: Fresher seq_num wins despite worse hop_count (same priority)

combined_ranking.name: realistic_rrep_update
combined_ranking.description: Typical RREP update: new route has fresher seq and better hop_count

combined_ranking.name: data_cannot_replace_explicit
combined_ranking.description: DATA-learned route cannot replace explicitly-advertised RREP even if fresher

coordinate_encoding.name: coords_seattle
coordinate_encoding.description: GradientEntry.coords for Seattle (47.6062, -122.3321) from app_data Type=0x01

coordinate_encoding.name: coords_null
coordinate_encoding.description: GradientEntry.coords can be None when announce has no app_data
